As a Lead IT Specialist (Program Manager), GS-2210-14, you will serve as the senior technical lead responsible for planning, coordinating, integrating, and delivering a mission-critical enterprise applications development program supporting public claims submission, claims processing, adjudication, and payment.

You will provide technical leadership and coordinate cross-functional teams to ensure successful program execution. Specific duties include: Lead the planning, execution, integration, and delivery of complex enterprise IT programs and digital modernization initiatives.

Develop and manage integrated project plans, schedules, milestones, delivery roadmaps, and performance measures to ensure successful project execution. Coordinate enterprise applications, case management systems, cybersecurity, contractors, and business stakeholders to deliver secure, integrated technology solutions.

Lead enterprise systems integration by ensuring interoperability across applications, APIs, workflows, identity management, data platforms, and legacy systems. Identify and resolve technical, operational, and organizational risks, dependencies, and integration challenges affecting project delivery.

Establish and maintain project governance processes, monitor contractor performance, and ensure compliance with federal IT lifecycle, acquisition, and project management requirements.

Integrate cybersecurity requirements throughout the system development lifecycle, coordinate Security Assessment and Authorization (SA&A) activities, and serve as the System Owner responsible for achieving and maintaining the Authority to Operate (ATO).

Prepare and deliver executive briefings, governance reports, and recommendations to senior Department leadership, including the Assistant CIO, Senior Executive Service officials, Justice Management Division, and the Office of Management and Budget.

Collaborate with business owners and technical stakeholders to gather requirements, support user acceptance testing, manage organizational change, and facilitate successful deployment of enterprise technology solutions.

Atticus is hiring an IT Specialist to own and mature our internal IT operations as we scale.

You’ll work closely with and report to the Information Security Manager, supporting day-to-day IT operations while helping improve the systems, processes, and tooling we rely on across endpoint device lifecycle management, identity and access, SaaS administration, and our broader cloud-first IT environment.

About us Atticus is a Melbourne-based scale-up founded in 2017, which offers the leading technology in document fact-checking. We are on a mission to ensure every critical document is accurate and defensible. Our software helps our customers (law firms, listed companies, and funds) fact-check critical documents before they are disclosed to market.

Our users love Atticus because we save them a lot of pain in high stakes work. We are a small, highly efficient team that relies on well-run internal systems to stay productive. As we grow, we are committed to preserving that speed while maintaining the security, reliability, and trust our customers expect.

That means giving our people simple, dependable tools and support, while ensuring our devices, access, and SaaS systems are managed in a secure and scalable way. About the role As our IT Specialist, you will keep Atticus ’s internal IT operations running smoothly while helping us build a more scalable, secure, and reliable technology environment.

You’ll act as a first point of contact with users, manage devices and access, improve integrations between platforms, and ensure our internal tools are reliable, secure, and easy to use. As a small and highly efficient company, this is a broad role suited to someone comfortable operating across multiple areas of IT.

You’ll need to take initiative, solve ambiguous or unfamiliar problems, follow through reliably, and balance responsive support with longer-term improvement work. From time to time, the role may involve after-hours support for our UK team, particularly for onboarding, offboarding, or urgent support needs.

You will also be accountable for driving the pace of projects that strengthen how we manage identity, devices, applications, data, and access. You’ll be working across a range of responsibilities that support the smooth running and ongoing improvement of our internal IT operations:

Internal IT support: Providing end-to-end technical support across user devices, applications, account access, and collaboration tools, helping staff resolve issues quickly with minimal disruption to their work.

Endpoint lifecycle management: Managing the full lifecycle of endpoint devices — primarily that our Apple fleet is consistently enrolled, configured, patched, and compliant, with a repeatable and well-documented lifecycle process from procurement through to retirement.

Apple device management & automation: Writing and maintaining scripts to support macOS administration, MDM workflows, app deployment, and compliance checks, improving consistency and scalability as we grow.

Identity & access management: Managing accounts, permissions, and access changes are managed accurately and promptly, onboarding and offboarding workflows are automated, and our IAM practices mature in line with the needs of the business.

SaaS & business systems administration: Managing and optimising core SaaS platforms to keep them reliable, secure, and well-integrated, while improving visibility and governance across the application stack.

Process improvement & automation: Identifying, prioritising, and improving manual IT processes to create faster workflows, reduce errors, and support a more scalable IT operation.

Security-aligned operations: Partnering with the Information Security Manager to ensure IT operations support broader security objectives across devices, users, applications, and access.

Documentation: Developing and maintaining technical documentation, runbooks, and user guides for end users, IT/security stakeholders, and future team members.
About you We’re looking for a capable and proactive IT professional with 3+ years of experience in IT, systems administration, endpoint management, IT operations, or a similar role. You enjoy helping people solve practical technology problems, but also care about improving the systems, processes, and automation that reduce friction over time.

You have a strong sense of ownership, are comfortable working independently in a broad role, and are looking for an opportunity to take greater ownership of a modern, cloud-first internal IT environment.

You have hands-on experience managing user devices, access, SaaS platforms, and identity-related tooling, and are comfortable balancing responsive support with longer-term improvement work.

Internal IT & user support: Experience providing end-to-end technical support across hardware, software, accounts, collaboration tools, and internal systems, including troubleshooting, escalations, and Apple device support.

Endpoint & device management: Solid understanding of endpoint management in macOS and Apple environments, including MDM, device enrolment, configuration, app deployment, patching, compliance, and the full device lifecycle.

Apple administration & scripting: Strong working knowledge of macOS administration with the ability to write or maintain scripts for Apple/Unix environments to support MDM workflows, app deployment, reporting, and repeatable IT operations.

Identity & access management: Experience managing identities, accounts, permissions, and lifecycle processes across business systems, with an understanding of identity providers, MFA, SSO, SCIM, and centralised access management.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.
With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.
Microsoft-s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

🏢 Who we are
A team from Germany with the vision to make advanced network security accessible for everyone
We are a software company developing an open-source zero-trust network security platform that is both easy to use and affordable for teams of all sizes and budgets. Our mission is grounded in a simple yet powerful belief: secure private networking is a fundamental right of every modern company.
Since our launch on GitHub in 2021, we have gained trust among thousands of companies seeking secure and seamless solutions for connecting remote employees and infrastructure.

By replacing traditional centralized VPNs, NetBird has become a trusted choice for modern network security, connecting today hundreds of thousands of users and machines worldwide. Our open-source, community-driven approach has been a key driver of our success.

We listen to our users, and their input helps us make network security better for everyone.
Want to see what we're working on? Check out our GitHub repo at https://github.com/netbirdio/netbird or https://netbird.io/knowledge-hub

In this role, you’ll work directly with customers to help them deploy and troubleshoot NetBird’s platform, ensuring a seamless and satisfying user experience. You’ll also collaborate with our Engineering and Product teams to identify improvements and shape the future of our platform.

Update and create documentation around the product
Partner with our sales and engineering team to ensure customers’ needs are met effectively.
Participate in team discussions to improve support processes and share insights with the broader team.
Advocate for product improvements and contribute to the team's continuous development.

Examples of IT-related experience demonstrating this competency include: completing thorough and accurate work independently, even in the most difficult or stressful situations; occasionally reviewing work completed by others.

(2) Customer Service - Works with clients and customers (that is, any individuals who use or receive the services or products that your work unit produces, including the general public, individuals who work in the agency, other agencies, or organizations outside the Government) to assess their needs, provide information or assistance, resolve their problems, or satisfy their expectations; knows about available products and services; is committed to providing quality products and services.

We believe that the way people interact with their finances will drastically improve in the next few years. Today, Plaid Support ensures our customers' applications can help their consumers live their best financial lives by ensuring our products continue to operate as expected. We investigate the root cause of integration issues, quantify their scope and impact, and when we can’t fix them ourselves, we work with our Go-to-Market, Engineering, and Product teams to reach a solution.
As we continue to grow, we’re looking for Technical Support Engineers (TSEs) to join the team to help us balance the needs of customers, users and internal stakeholders, while navigating critical technical issues.

In this role, you will manage issues from their first symptom to their eventual resolution, communicating with our customers and internal stakeholders throughout the process. People who succeed in this role tend to be empathetic, collaborative, technically minded, and most importantly - customer-centric.

They have an interest in learning more about financial services, and are excited to help customers resolve complex issues. TSEs become embedded within engineering teams at Plaid, and we have a high technical bar to ensure that we all speak the same language.

Our Support team sets aggressive goals to meet the standards our customers expect, and we collaborate cross-functionally with our Engineering, Product, Financial Access, and Go-to-Market teams in order to achieve these goals.
